correctness.rationale: The precise support-normal reduction, planar support-area formula and finite enumeration cover every admissible chord quadrilateral. The embedded rational interval script checks cubic-root isolation, each denominator, all 1548 bounded quadruples, all 90 bounded edge-only quadruples, strict gaps and ninefold equality orbits, and runs with standard Python 3. These checks use exact fractions, not floating point, and a fixed finite theorem needs no extension to infinity.

value.rationale: The full nonagon calculation supplies a complete optimizer classification for the natural chord-enclosure invariant and quantifies a strict, geometrically motivated loss when chord directions are restricted to original polygon edges. In particular it gives a useful counterexample to edge-only reduction strategies for the recent polygonal chord conjecture, not merely another numerical ratio.
